name: Swiss Modern
tagline: White page, black type, one red accent, a visible 12-column grid and flat geometric shapes in asymmetric layouts. Adapted from the Swiss Modern preset in frontend-slides.

palette.description: pure white page with a faint visible column grid, pure black type and shapes, one signal red for the key word, number, shape or column; light grey only for quiet fields and 'before' data

typography.style: Archivo 800 in sentence case with very tight tracking for headlines, numbers and small uppercase labels; Nunito 400/700 for body text

best_for: Design reviews, architecture, planning and public-sector briefings, strategy and board decisions — content that should look objective and well-ordered. Strong for big numbers, option tables, timelines and principle sets.
avoid_for: Warm, emotional or playful storytelling, dense text documents, and brands built around soft colors or photography. The strict grid and black-red palette feel cool and institutional.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
